title: Encoding a parity product
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S$ be a subset of its coordinates, and let $g$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The binary encoding of the pointwise product of the parity function on $S$ with $g$ is the pointwise sum in $\mathbb F_2$ of the coordinate sum on $S$ and the binary encoding of $g$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued Boolean function $g$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
